## Parental OpControl 0.17.9

- Websites now has a **Public AI chats** category, off by default. Turn it on for a child to block public AI chat sites (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Grok, DeepSeek, Perplexity and more), AI companion apps (Character.AI, Talkie, Replika and more) and free copy sites.
- The category explains what it does and does not block. It cannot separate AI answers inside Google or Brave search, AI inside Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, Snapchat, Discord or X, or AI features built into browsers or Windows. Those need separate browser/Windows controls later.
- The Luna welcome popup's button opens the new category, and the child page tip now shows only while the category is off for that child.
- The list is versioned and updated with the app; a guarded-domain check prevents shared or school sites from being blocked.
- This release is installed on the X1 only; the Yoga is not updated. Luna stays enabled with the same key.
